purpose: Measure the actual production CPU frozen initial force/complete-rate Jacobian before further loaded case02 integration; manufactured basis values are not an evolved or validated physical trajectory.

dependency.usage: One renamed main / one AppInfo; only declarations/utilities, not its reader/wave gates or old main. Existing project headers/libraries only.

input_scope: Use the unchanged original1040-particle case02 seed/runtime already sealed by case02 preparation (1000soil/40fixed, dp.01, height1,width.1, pureXperiodic, upward FreeSlip bottom, gravity0). No GenCase or new geometry. Future caller must hash-bind actual runtime+BI4+Normals and current build/program; this CPP does not claim source SHA or owned exit verification.

model.conductivity: constant float1e-4 m/s; no Ck law
model.material: Actual float n0=.3, MassFluid=MassBound=.21, rho0=2100, rhow=1000, Kw2e8, K1666666.75, G769230.8125; PoreDtSafety1. No viscosity/HG/SPR/damping/shifting/DDT/artificial stress/Shepard/softening.
model.time: TimeStep=Nstep=0 throughout; actual runtime dt retained, no integration or save call. q(t0)=0 and future drain at.01 inactive.

lifecycle.initialization: Constructor sets private flags before LoadConfig. AppName/Log/CfgRun; Timersc.Config(false); LoadConfig; LoadCaseParticles; VisuConfig; ConfigDomain; ConfigRunMode; InitRunCpu; FreePartsInit; RunCellDivide(true). Same proven path as upl_porosity_operator_r1.cpp:69, without Run.
lifecycle.source_locations: JSphCpuSingle.cpp ConfigDomain/RunCellDivide623; Interaction_Forces750–815; JSphCpu.cpp completeRate4377–4458 and PostInteraction2038–2051.
lifecycle.each_probe: Reset only normal soil v/sigma/p/p0/plastic/J/theta/rate to the declared basis with J1/rho0; true RunCellDivide(true) retires/regenerates periodic copies. Boundary J/p/sigma and derivative velocity are never manufactured: the actual force's wall MLS rebuilds them. Clearing derivative-output rate to0 defines all slots, not a boundary-pressure replacement.
lifecycle.actual_force: Interaction_Forces(INTERSTEP_SymPredictor), download/read Ace.z/Rsigma.zz/PorePressRate/theta before PosInteraction_Forces. No direct substitute ct or copied formula.
lifecycle.checks: Normal IDs identify40fixed/1000soil regardless Np/Npb periodic extension. Normal soil physical input/geometry bytes must remain unchanged by force; physical fixed positions/velocities remain fixed, but derived wall stress/p/J may legitimately change. Initial C and FSType must remain exact per normal soil ID; completed fluid periodic J/C/Ace/theta/rate must bit-match actual owners.
lifecycle.cleanup: PosInteraction_Forces releases actual Ace/Arc/Rsigma/raw-band/derivative scratch after outputs copied. Clock, locked dt, LastDt, FixedDt error and absence of predictor histories checked throughout. Final normal soil basis reset tozero. No all-persistent-diagnostic/statistics or fixed-quadrature whole-object rollback claim.

basis.coordinate: 100 material z layers(index0..99),10 normal soil columns per layer. No position perturbation or J perturbation.
basis.amplitudes: vz is actual double(float(.001))m/s; stress1Pa; pore pressure1Pa; both signs. Smoke also half of each actual amplitude (dyadic exact scaling).
basis.stress_shape: sigma_xx=sigma_yy=(lambda/M)*sigma_zz; lambda=actualK−2actualG/3, M=actualK+4actualG/3; shear0. No constitutive/integrator call is suppressed or overridden; force only evaluates its real stress rate.
basis.smoke_counts: Strict zero state1 force +4sources*4signed/amplitude evaluations=17actual force calls,17explicit noAce rate calls,1700layer response rows. No matrix file or spectral conclusion.
basis.matrix_counts: Strict zero1 +300sources*2signs=601actual force calls,601explicit noAce rate calls,60100layer response rows. True central-difference projected Jacobian300x300, plus theta100x300. Matrix is a measured 1D projection, not a claim of all1040*3 eigenmodes.
basis.matrix_output_order: Rows0..99=mean az layer0..99;100..199=mean actual Rsigma_zz;200..299=mean complete pdot. Ten columns equally weighted, consistent layer projection, no smoothing or fitting.

noAce_diagnostic: After the full real force, preserve all defined Ace/rate and constant-law cache, set Ace scratch to0 and call real ComputeDynamicPorePressureRateCpu once. Copy that rate, then restore Ace/rate byte-exact and cache. This is an explicit frozen component decomposition, never a production fix. With J1: compression=−Kw/n0*mean(theta); pressure contribution=pdot_noAce−compression; acceleration contribution=pdot−pdot_noAce. Float complete-rate rounding remains visible, no native q claim.

arithmetic_probe_policy.zero_source: All normal soil AceXYZ/Rsigma6/pdot/theta strictly0 at manufactured zero state.
arithmetic_probe_policy.spreads: For each channel, record per-layer mean and max−min across10columns, and global per-probe peak. Budget=64FLT_EPS*max(1,peak)+256DBL_EPS*max(1,peak), in the declared output units. No fitted limit or general error theorem.
arithmetic_probe_policy.oddness: mean(+a)+mean(−a) checked against the same budget using both response peaks; all raw responses retained.
arithmetic_probe_policy.amplitude_linearity: Smoke compares central derivatives at full and half amplitudes, using the same arithmetic envelope on max(1,abs derivative). Matrix only sign pairs, not an additional half-amplitude sweep.
arithmetic_probe_policy.interpretation: A budget failure rejects arithmetic/projection reliability of this manufactured probe, not proof of physical or semidiscrete instability. Raw maxima/spreads and error ratios are retained; no pressure5Pa/half displacement/.01CFL/wave energy gate is altered.

outputs.responses: One row per real force/output layer: call/source family/layer/actual amplitude; az,Rsigma_zz,pdot,theta,pdot_noAce means, column spreads, explicit global peak and arithmetic budget; compression/pressure/acceleration diagnostic terms and actual production wave/pore scales.
outputs.linearity: One source-column row with raw amplitude and oddness/half-amplitude error ratios; responses retain explicit raw channel peaks/budgets and every layer, allowing direct reconstruction of each signed/half-amplitude check.
outputs.fresh: Input XML/BI4 must exist and output directory must not; failure keeps partial output, no automatic rerun.

held: No eigenvalue or integrator stability conclusion computed by this helper
No nonzero top-load spatial distribution, later time-source sampling or drainage switch audited at t0
No reinterpretation of original coarse or dt-only diagnostic failures as passed
